title: Negative-evidence audit of VT-B rejection, selection and cheap validation
objective: Test whether current VT-B operators use recurring evidence-based rejection/selection rules or whether value-form routing remains irreducible curator taste.
truth_rules: FAILURE TO SELL IS VALID EVIDENCE
A REUSABLE REJECTION KERNEL != AN OPEN BUSINESS EDGE
RIGHTS STRUCTURE MAY STANDARDIZE WHILE SPLIT PERCENTAGES DO NOT

observed_negative_evidence.pattern: legacy form can be genuinely unmarketable even when the underlying capability is strong

evidence.fact: The original Shaoxing West-Lake baskets were highly homogeneous, old-fashioned in shape/color, low-use-context fit and remained unsold even at about RMB6; earlier attempts such as stalls and second-hand platforms reportedly produced little response.
A 2026 craft-market discussion states that labor-intensive handmade goods without distinctive design/artistic value can fail to gain market recognition even when labor time is high.

observed_negative_evidence.implication: The older asset may be real while the current value form deserves rejection.

observed_negative_evidence.pattern: channel/context can invalidate a previously successful form

evidence.fact: Tǎmadrama observed that after entering a shopping mall, product-only retail did not attract the surrounding resident customer base sufficiently; it added pottery classes and later livestream selling.

observed_negative_evidence.implication: A form that worked in one traffic/context regime can fail in another; routing requires context-sensitive kill/switch rules.

observed_negative_evidence.pattern: traditional form pushed directly to a new market can underperform

evidence.fact: Funan willow-weaving firms reported that directly taking traditional local styles overseas produced mediocre market response; they later adapted color, dimensions and product use to regional consumer habits and used small-batch trial sales before iterative optimization.

observed_negative_evidence.implication: Target-user/use-context fit must be tested; heritage value alone does not carry across markets.

observed_negative_evidence.pattern: formal channels use explicit delisting rules

evidence.fact: A 2026-2027 Guangdong intangible-cultural-heritage museum retail operator notice requires dynamic product refresh and states that products with poor sales should be replaced or delisted; it also requires quality checks, stable pricing, IP compliance and after-sales mechanisms.
evidence.evidence_role: channel-operation benchmark; not specifically a senior-asset program

observed_negative_evidence.implication: At the channel layer, kill criteria are normal operating practice rather than an exception.

evidence.fact: In the current Shaoxing basket program, student designers first make design images and have student groups view, rate and score them; higher-scoring designs are then incorporated into products.
Funan willow-weaving operators use small-batch trial sales and optimize based on market feedback after tailoring product use/color/size to target regions.
Tǎmadrama changed from product-only retail toward classes and livestream after observing mall-customer behavior and channel performance.
Current cultural retail operating rules explicitly require poor-selling products to be replaced or removed from shelves.

evidence: traditional local forms underperformed when pushed unchanged to other markets
product-only retail underperformed when mall context favored experience
successful redesigns made older products fit commuting, gifting, home and younger-consumer scenarios
current craft guidance repeatedly distinguishes products that re-enter daily life from display-only forms
retail/context evidence shows experience/class forms can outperform pure product form in some settings
high labor time without distinctive design may not earn market recognition
Shaoxing uses redesign and peer scoring before incorporating new patterns/forms
current commercialization practice treats cost-to-terminal-price relationship as a viability boundary
complex/high-cost craft categories face limited addressable demand even when quality is strong
mall, street/pop-up, livestream, class and overseas consumer contexts produce different responses
operators switch form/channel when observed behavior changes
formal retail channels require quality inspection, after-sales handling and IP compliance
current copyright practice shows provenance and licensing matter before scaled derivative use

cross_operator_selection_kernel.interpretation: A first-stage rejection/selection kernel is increasingly evidence-driven and partially reusable. It is not purely curator taste.

explanation: Operators can standardize early rejection around user fit, use scenario, cost, production feasibility, compliance and cheap market signals.
What remains highly human is choosing and creating the specific contemporary expression: product architecture, story, aesthetic, class/experience design and channel strategy.
Evidence can eliminate bad routes earlier, but it does not automatically invent the good route.

actual_patterns.fact: Shaoxing basket program uses an explicit public 80% producer / 20% community-fund revenue split.
National copyright reporting shows folk artists increasingly register works, license derivative development and receive ongoing per-unit/royalty-style income instead of one-time sale only.

Current copyright pilot reporting shows standardized authorization can turn one work into repeated licensing revenue; some local artists report multi-use authorization income materially above one-off sales.
Fengtai plans IP protection and artisan certification as part of the operating layer but does not publish a universal revenue split.

conflict_evidence.fact: Current craft-design research documents recurring economic-distribution and IP conflicts between tradition holders and designers; one cited pattern required renegotiation from one-time payment toward base license plus tiered sharing after disagreement about contribution value.

rights_revenue_sharing_audit.conclusion: Reusable structure exists at the level of consent/provenance/licensing/attribution/revenue-sharing agreements, but no universal split percentage is supported. Economic contribution remains negotiated and context-dependent.

evidence.fact: A 2026 design study proposes resource intake → AI/design generation → expert validation → prototype → user testing → batch conversion, with virtual samples, surveys and small-batch trials judged by clicks, favorites, trial reviews and conversion rates.

adjacent_normative_test_protocol.role: This is not proof that senior-asset operators already use a universal protocol. It shows the observed selection signals can be expressed as a known low-cost product-validation discipline.

decisive_verdict.core_statement: The strongest reusable primitive is not automatic value-form recommendation. It is evidence-guided portfolio formation: reject weak source/form/channel combinations cheaply, deepen only assets that survive user/use/cost/quality/context tests, then let human creative routing operate on a smaller qualified set.

contradiction_audit: This evidence-guided selection discipline is not unique to older-adult assets; it is standard product/portfolio management in many creative markets.
Existing designers, retailers and cultural operators already perform these functions.
The elder-source-specific problem may therefore lie upstream in capability discovery/provenance or downstream in rights/channel access, not in generic testing methodology.
Selection criteria can be standardized without making value creation itself scalable.
Public/community infrastructure still subsidizes discovery, space, trust and youth participation in several strongest cases.
next_action: Audit transfer learning and elder-specific irreducible friction. Search whether operators accumulate reusable knowledge from one successful/rejected elder asset to improve future unrelated selections; whether the same criteria transfer across craft, teaching, memory, knowledge and content; and which frictions remain specifically because the source is an older person's embodied/rights-sensitive asset rather than any ordinary creative product. Kill the generalized routing thesis if the remaining work reduces to generic product management plus manual creative direction.
